sources.text: Our Medical Assisting students recently attended the HealthLink Managed Care Conference, where they had the opportunity to expand their knowledge beyond the classroom and connect with healthcare professionals from across the industry. Students networked with clinic staff, managers, healthcare providers and insurance representatives while learning more about healthcare costs, managed care and how these factors connect to direct patient care. Experiences like these give our students a broader look at the healthcare field and help prepare them for the realities of the profession they’re entering!

sources.title: Photos from Baldwyn School District's post
sources.text: ✨🌌 Learning about the Northern Lights! 🌌✨ Mrs. Manley’s 6th graders have been learning all about the Aurora Borealis (Northern Lights)—from what causes them to the amazing colors and patterns they create! To bring their learning to life, students created their own Aurora Borealis artwork using watercolors and oil pastels. 🎨🌈 We love seeing science and art come together! 💙💚💜 #heartofabearcat
